name: Aftermarket Auto Parts Alliance
old_description: Since 1978, we have been supplying our customers with not only the auto parts they seek, but a level of customer service and commitment unmatched. And you don’t have to be an auto dealer or auto repair facility to buy the auto parts you need. Stop by and see us and one of our friendly Parts Specialists will help you out.
about:
Aftermarket Auto Parts Alliance is headquartered in San Antonio, Texas, and traces its origins to 1978. The organization operates as a cooperative network of independent warehouse distributors rather than a single-owner enterprise; no individual founders are named in public materials. It began as a program to supply auto parts and service support to independent businesses across North America and has since expanded its footprint to include Mexico, Honduras, Colombia, Belize, Europe, and China.

The alliance manages two consumer-facing brands — Auto Value and Bumper to Bumper — under which thousands of parts stores and certified service centers operate. Its core services include warehouse distribution, private-label parts branding (Perfect Stop, Parts Master, Perfect View, MacPherson, Ultra Stop, Auto Body Master), a proprietary electronic ordering platform called MyPlace4Parts, and warranty programs such as Confidence Plus North American Warranty and SafeRoute Roadside Assistance. The network reports approximately 3,500 certified service centers in the United States and Canada, supported by financing options and technical training for members.

Primary customers are independent automotive repair shops, parts retailers, and warehouse distributors within the automotive aftermarket. The alliance also serves fleet operators and DIY consumers through its retail locations. Member distributors such as Auto-Wares, Hahn Automotive Warehouse, and Superior Automotive Warehouse illustrate the wholesale tier, while certified service centers like Highway 7 Service Center (Iowa) and Ste-Agathe Service Centre (Manitoba) represent the retail-repair tier.

The organization emphasizes service differentiation — encapsulated in the tagline "SERVICE is the difference. We get it!" — and positions itself as a partner that provides tools, training, marketing support, and a collective voice for independents in the aftermarket. Its warranty coverage is honored across all network locations, and the ordering platform is designed to reduce administrative burden for repair shops.
